literature_basis.summary: Aso et al. 2014 reported avoidance-associated glutamatergic MBON activation and attraction-associated GABAergic/cholinergic MBON activation at population level.

interpretation_boundary: The game reward-to-valence-channel mapping is a project-defined model interface. R2c does not punish a no-damage draw; engagement signal is positive only when the horizontal potential improves, while actual damage/loss can supply negative signal.
